requirement: Users shall be able to enter text in a browser search field and receive a list of Nobel Prize laureate name suggestions as they type. Suggestions shall come from the application's local JSON data. Each suggested name shall start with the entered text, and the list shall contain no more than ten results.

The application shall provide a browser-accessible home page for laureate search and serve its required public web resources. If the home page or a requested public resource cannot be read, the server shall return an HTML not-found response with HTTP status 404.
The application shall run with a JavaScript server on Node.js and support startup through the documented start script and deployment to Heroku.
